'''2007 Worlds Day 2 Bill Kafer LS We'll Handle This''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Bill Kafer]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck title Like Prior's Elbow - BROKED! GLiGl (V) → [[Glancing Blow (V)]] uncertain. HCF → [[Han, Chewie, And The Falcon]].


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Bill Kafer]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[We'll Handle This / Duel Of The Fates|We'll Handle This]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
